$Comment: The long-haul tithe: once a player is deep enough into the codex, blood and timber buy a
mastery point every six hours, forever.
It is the only repeating source of mastery points that asks for no essence at all, which is
what makes it worth holding on a character who has run the essence quests dry. Repeat.Cooldown
is a ROLLING six hours measured from the claim, not a calendar reset, so it comes round four
times in a day for somebody playing through and once for somebody who logs on each evening.
Widen or narrow it by editing the Hours.
AutoAccept puts it in the log the moment a player qualifies, so nobody has to know it exists.
The Requires block is what holds it back until then: 500 total levels across every skill, and
the 300-point hoarder achievement, on top of mastery being switched on at all. Those two are
deliberately steep, since a point every six hours compounds; drop either one to open it
Neither step names a target, which is what makes them mean ANY creature and ANY wood: the
tithe is paid with whatever the evening put in front of the player rather than by hunting one
species or one tree. Name a Target on either to narrow it.
The reward is one mastery point, paid on collection rather than the instant the last log
falls, so the player chooses when to bank it.
Name: Pack_Mastery_Tithe
